description: Department of Census and Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index for the month of January 2016 was 112.0
categorisation: This gazette content announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for January 2016, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities (Types 1-3). It also does not fit any specialized categories such as land, legal/regulatory, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial/law enforcement matters (Types 4-9). This is a statistical announcement falling under general administrative matters, making it Type 10 (Miscellaneous).
